note: Three independent implementations of TuRBO on the same closed-form objective, same box, same budget, same initial-design size, same seeds. This compares implementations, not methods: TuRBO is a specification with a lot of unstated detail, and agreement between independent readings of it is evidence the detail was read the same way.
caveat: Surrogate fitting differs and is not matched: both Python references fit GP hyperparameters every step, FortBO runs a fixed lengthscale. Any gap belongs to that difference before it belongs to the trust-region logic.

roomy_budget.comment: At this budget the authors' own code has TuRBO-1 ahead of TuRBO-5, with TuRBO-5 barely ahead of random. FortBO shows the same ordering. The paper's advantage for several regions comes from thousands of evaluations, not tens.
